integrity: A standalone finite checker corroborates the unrestricted written proof; finite testing is not a proof of the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary P3 convexity only, powers of labelled simple cycles of order at least three and integer power at least two.
No automorphism quotient, no general circular-arc graph extension, and no induced-path convexity.
Literature priority remains provisional and independent mathematical assessment was not performed.
title: Complete \(P_3\)-convexity polynomial of cycle powers
